nodes.name: Get Open Tasks
nodes.notes: Create an HTTP Header Auth credential with header 'Authorization: Bearer <TWENTY_API_KEY>'.

nodes.name: Send Digest Email
nodes.notes: Requires an SMTP credential + NOTIFY_FROM_EMAIL / NOTIFY_TO_EMAIL env vars. Swap for a Slack node if you prefer chat notifications.

meta.description: Runs weekday mornings, pulls open Tasks from Twenty, and emails a digest of anything overdue or due today. Adjust the cron expression and the REST filter query as needed.
